answer: Each identity posts batches of ten, locking a 200-credit bond on the nebula ledger per batch. The k-th fake batch locks 200, so 1,000 fake batches risk 200,000, no bulk discount, each bond bound to one batch key. At the lantern checkpoint, the batch is verified: all ten must pass, and one bad item burns the bond, voiding payment. Batch-padding fails: fakes void a batch payment, and batches under ten are refused. Items outside a batch are wander: they earn nothing. An honest identity passes all ten and keeps its bond; results are recomputable from the ledger.
